interface.signature: def check(N: int, M: int, Edges: list) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of vertices N is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The number of edges M is between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(e) == 2 and 1 <= e[0] <= N and 1 <= e[1] <= N for e in Edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge in Edges is a list of exactly two integers representing valid vertex labels between 1 and N.
The length of the Edges list equals M.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (any(all((p[i], p[i+1]) in edge_set or (p[i+1], p[i]) in edge_set for i in range(N-1)) for p in __import__('itertools').permutations(range(1, N+1))))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if there exists a permutation of all vertices from 1 to N such that every consecutive pair in the permutation is connected by an edge in the graph; otherwise it returns False.
